evidence: The thickness of all the films was measured by both ellipsometer and transmission electron microscope (TEM). The microstructures of all the films were characterized by a 200 kV field emission TEM (Tecnai F20). The TEM specimens were prepared using FIB etching technique to reveal the cross section of the Cu/AlN/Pt structure. Topographic images of the films were obtained using an atomic force microscope (AFM, Veeco) in the tapping mode at a nominal load of ∼ 2 nN, and the scanning rate for a 1 × 1 /H9262m image was 1.0 Hz. The chemical state of each element in the films was analyzed by x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, Escalab 250Xi) with Al K/H9251 radiation of 1486.6 eV.
